entries.name: bth_named_thread_count_hint
entries.evidence: Static named RTOS thread literals in BTH image (16): app_thread, app_bt_cmd_thread, hci_rx_thread, bth_if_thread, APPTHREAD, BesbtThread, af_thread, xjxr_audio_event_thread, xjxr_audio_msg_handler_thread, bth_dsp_tx_thread, ota_thread, rpc_rx_thread, eshell_rpc_rx_thread, eshell_thread..., restart_eshell_thread, intersys_tx_thread_id. Compile-time OS_THREAD_NUM not recovered as a literal; this is a lower-bound concurrency footprint.

entries.name: intersys_invalid_msg_type
entries.value: typed INTERSYS msgs; invalid type rejected on RX/TX
entries.evidence: INTERSYS-RX: Invalid msg type: %d; INTERSYS-TX: Invalid msg type: %d. Concrete byte max payload size not present as a string literal (UNRECOVERED); type enum is the hard protocol bound.

entries.name: rmt_ipc_tx_too_fast
entries.evidence: BTH '[%s] error -1, TX too fast' @0xe5f30; hub identical string @0x12b28 (hal_rmt_ipc flow control)

entries.name: osif_thread_gate_serialization
entries.evidence: osif_rtx.c @0x13005c; 'request_thread:%s' @0x1300a0, 'hold_thread:%s' @0x1300b4; also 'request thread=%s' / 'hold thread=%s'. Late thread bring-up is serialized through this OSIF gate (concurrency constraint, not a numeric thread cap).
